_about: Seed list for .get-found/listings.json. types = site types it fits ('*' = all). priority: core (do first), high, nice. countries/verticals limit where it applies. Status verified 2026-11-02 where noted; always open the submit page before recommending — directories change owners, prices and rules. Never use paid link schemes or mass-submission services (Google link-spam policy).

directories.name: Google Business Profile
directories.notes: Maps + local pack + Gemini answers in Maps. Q&A section retired 2025-26.

directories.name: Bing Places for Business
directories.notes: Relaunched Oct 2025; import from Google Business Profile gives instant verification.

directories.name: Apple Business (Maps / Siri)
directories.notes: Replaced Apple Business Connect on 2026-04-14. Check country availability.

directories.name: Google Merchant Center (free listings)
directories.notes: Products in Search, Shopping, Images, Lens, YouTube, Gemini. Needs shipping/returns settings.

directories.name: Microsoft Merchant Center
directories.notes: Free product listings on Bing/Copilot shopping; can import from Google.

directories.name: Product Hunt
directories.notes: One launch; prepare assets. Don't ask for upvotes directly.

directories.name: Hacker News — Show HN
directories.notes: Must be usable without signup; no landing pages; no vote rings.
